scope: P4 component kernels only; no end-to-end simulation claim
reference: Original small CPU chronological fixture, first daytime call with altitude above 30 degrees; captured function-entry arguments
fixture_policy: Repeat all spatial input axes consistently, preserving patch axis and scalar forcing; synthetic component workload, not a changed logical simulation domain
first_call: Fresh process and empty JIT cache; imports and fixture loading excluded; includes compilation and descriptor construction
mutable_inputs: Fresh independent copies before every call; preparation outside timer; release previous outputs before next call
memory: Process lifetime peak RSS including imports, fixtures, JIT and output export; not process-tree or stage-only memory
correctness: Input hashes equal; compare every component with unchanged comparison_v1 field gates, masks exact; compare observable argument mutations
archive: Raw calls, failures, dependency/thread environment, source/harness/protocol hashes and numeric outputs retained
platform: Apple M1 Pro macOS ARM64; CUDA unavailable
interpretation: Warm variation reflects repeated calls in one process; no cross-platform or universal speedup claim
